description: This file is a web-based PHP script for managing port triggering settings on a router or network device. It includes UI components, JavaScript for interactivity, and PHP code for server-side processing, data retrieval, and dynamic content generation related to port triggering rules.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string or boolean configuration values from device parameters based on their path.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list of instance IDs for a given device object.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for specified device objects, returning arrays of their attributes.
